title: Mobile Service Tracker
summary: Where it all started: repair intake, status and delivery for a mobile shop.
problem: Repairs were tracked on paper. Customers kept calling to ask about status.
solution: A service tracker for intake, repair status, technician notes and delivery dates.

features.title: Job cards
features.description: Every phone gets a job card at intake.

features.title: Status updates
features.description: Staff see what is pending, ready or delivered.

results: The first system, still the base of the shop's workflow

testimonial.quote: The service tracking app improved how we handle repairs. Customers receive clearer updates and our front desk runs smoother.
testimonial.name: Logu
